razonamiento: The architecture shows the AWS CloudEndure Migration Factory solution. There are 9 components drawn on the whiteboard and corroborated by the narration: the on-premises servers (OnPremDC), AppDiscovery, DynamoDB (storing migration metadata), the Migration Factory EC2 instance, Slack, CloudEndure, an EC2 staging instance receiving block-level replication, target account EC2 instances, and the migration team actor. All 10 drawn lines match spoken interaction flows (metadata population, discovery query, replication, Slack trigger, CloudEndure orchestration, and target account instance launch).
nombre: Automated Cloud Migration with CloudEndure Migration Factory
